findings: Callback audit log banca_id hardcoded — The `agt_callback` view creates audit logs with `banca_id=1` instead of deriving it from the fatura via SubmissaoAgt. This breaks multi-tenant audit trails and could log webhooks against the wrong tenant.

XML payload generation is placeholder — The `_build_fatura_xml()` method returns a simplified XML structure suitable for testing but not production. Real SAF-T XML generation per AGT specification is required before live deployment.

State machine retry guard missing — The `submeter_fatura()` method does not check `proxima_tentativa_em` before attempting resubmission. If called again before the 15-minute window expires, it will bypass the throttle and attempt to submit again, potentially triggering AGT rate limits or double-submission errors.

Private key loading does not fail fast — If AgtCryptoService cannot load the private key, it logs and returns an empty string, which will cause jwt.encode() to fail later with an opaque error. Initialization should raise an exception on missing key to fail fast.
